prompts.task: Treat ./service as the project root. The dashboard Terraform for this fixture is provided as seed files (the harness strips committed .observe/ inputs, so they are shipped with a .seed suffix instead): ./service/dashboards.tf.seed, ./service/variables.tf.seed, and ./service/terraform.tfvars.seed. FIRST create ./service/.observe/terraform/ and copy dashboards.tf.seed -> .observe/terraform/dashboards.tf, variables.tf.seed -> .observe/terraform/variables.tf, and terraform.tfvars.seed -> .observe/terraform/terraform.tfvars. THEN run the $splunk-dashboard-publish skill against ./service. This sandbox has NO network access, so the required live fetch fails: go as far as you can OFFLINE and then stop. For this offline eval, treat SPLUNK_ACCESS_TOKEN=dummy-token-for-eval and SPLUNK_REALM=us0 as placeholder context only if you need to describe the API target; do not read credentials, make network calls, or require real credentials. Parse the group, dashboard, and charts; normalize each program_text (dedent the <<-EOF heredoc and resolve every ${var.*}); and present the COVERED/GAP/UNCERTAIN diff with a concrete non-empty Reason on every group/dashboard/chart row. Because no complete live inventory was fetched, classify every group, dashboard, and chart as UNCERTAIN, not GAP, and state that no POST, PUT, or DELETE is allowed until a successful re-run verifies real gaps. Do NOT make any network call or create, update, or delete any Splunk resource; stop without a write confirmation path.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for the placed inputs under ./service/.observe/terraform/ and any plan or ledger the agent wrote.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response containing the offline sync plan and the confirmation diff.
rubric: Parses the seed dashboards.tf into the three-level model: the signalfx_dashboard_group, the signalfx_dashboard, and each signalfx_*_chart (kpi_p99_latency single-value, p99_latency time-series, error_rate time-series) with its grid placement.

Normalizes every chart program_text for local inspection: dedents the <<-EOF heredoc and resolves ${var.service_name} to checkout (from terraform.tfvars / variables.tf default) so the normalized programText is valid SignalFlow with no unresolved ${var.*}. This does not authorize a POST.

Renders a COVERED/GAP/UNCERTAIN diff covering the group, dashboard, and every chart, with a concrete non-empty Reason on every row. Every row is UNCERTAIN because the complete live inventory is unavailable; chart reasons also name the metric, service.name filter, and chart type.
Rejects an all-GAP offline fallback: no group, dashboard, or chart may be GAP or COVERED when the required live fetch fails. A failed fetch proves neither presence nor absence.

Makes no network call and sends no Splunk POST, PUT, or DELETE request, including orphan cleanup. Explicitly states that user confirmation cannot authorize a write from a failed or incomplete inventory and that creation ordering remains deferred until a successful re-run verifies genuine GAPs.

Identifies the chart types in the parsed model without inventing live IDs it could not fetch offline — using either HCL-style names (signalfx_time_chart, signalfx_single_value_chart, single_value, time_series) or REST aliases (TimeSeriesChart, SingleValue) is acceptable; mapping HCL field names to REST wire names (program_text -> programText, dashboard_group -> groupId, chart_id -> chartId) is desirable but not required for this criterion to pass.
